scope: Exact finite-N=6 Floquet-Lindblad topology-control campaign with a common physical product preparation. Closed-chain BDI invariants classify drive controls only; no dissipative phase-boundary or thermodynamic-limit claim is permitted.

common_model.full_model_declaration: No Floquet pair selection, B^(0) construction, numerical Floquet index, or phase convention is used in any full-model preparation.

readout.phasor: A_TLS=|2/(t_f-t_dis) integral[c_d(t)-mean(c_d)] exp(+i Omega t/2) dt|
readout.spectral_weight: W_r=integral |A_TLS(r)|^2 dr on the fixed ratio grid

pi_matched.purpose: Strictly same-period comparison (1,1) versus (0,1), isolating the change of nu0 at fixed nupi=1.

zero_matched.purpose: Strictly same-period comparison (1,0) versus (0,0), isolating the change of nu0 at fixed nupi=0.

spatial_profile.purpose: Production (1,1) OBC full-model edge-to-interior profile without pair preparation.
spatial_profile.report: W_r(m) for all m=0..5 and the directional W_r(0)/W_r(3) reference ratio. No localization-length fit is claimed from N=6.

numerical_convergence.purpose: Check that weak PBC/trivial signals are not artifacts of sampling or phasor-window discard.
numerical_convergence.acceptance: Each variant must have normalized-shape distance D<=0.10 relative to the 4-samples, 20-period-discard baseline. Otherwise mark all v3 spectral conclusions sampling/window-sensitive.

heldout_same_drive_PBC.purpose: Second independent boundary-condition control at the predeclared held-out (1,1) drive.

directional_metrics_and_interpretation.report_all: For each matched pair report W ratio in declared numerator/denominator order, D, peak locations/splitting under the frozen grid rule, and raw peak ratio. Do not replace a directional ratio with max(Wa/Wb,Wb/Wa).
directional_metrics_and_interpretation.pi_specificity_rule: Do not claim pi-specificity from one ratio. A finite-system pi-associated pattern requires the two nupi=1 cases to be mutually more similar in normalized shape than either is to its matched nupi=0 reference trend, together with a held-out OBC/PBC boundary contrast. If this qualitative pattern is absent or ambiguous, report four-class data without a pi-specific causal claim.
directional_metrics_and_interpretation.stop_rule: No additional parameter search, N>6 run, reduced-model expansion, or retuning is authorized after these declared controls.

provenance.before_run: Publicly commit this protocol, candidate-search scripts, selected-control JSON, and v3 production script. Every new JSON records protocol/script SHA-256, Git commit, UTC timestamps, exact command and result self-hash.
provenance.language: Prospectively frozen numerical protocol; never formal preregistration.
